description: This file defines the TypeCastUtil class, which provides utility methods for casting string values to specific data types such as number, boolean, JSON, or string, based on content analysis.

classes.name: TypeCastUtil
classes.description: A utility class for casting string values to various data types, including number, boolean, JSON, or string.

methods.name: castValue
methods.description: Casts a string value to a Pair of DataType and Object, determining the type based on content.

methods.name: castToNumber
methods.description: Casts a string value to a Pair of DataType and Number, specifically handling numeric conversions.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if a string represents a valid number.

methods.name: isSimpleDouble
methods.description: Determines if a string looks like a simple double (contains '.' but no 'E' or 'e').

methods.name: looksLikeJson
methods.description: Checks if a string appears to be JSON (starts and ends with {} or []).
